For a renter, I’d look at a **portable power station plus a portable panel**, not a kit that plugs into your apartment wiring. The **[BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit)** is a compact option: its 288 Wh battery can power phones, a laptop, router, or fan, and you can bring the panel inside when you’re done. It’s **not enough for a fridge or heater**. The listed price is $489.99 before the deal code shown on the seller’s page. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-for-an-apartment-balcony))

Set the panel out only where it’s stable and allowed by your lease or building rules; balcony sun and shade will affect how quickly it recharges. The station stores power for you to use indoors—**it doesn’t feed power into your apartment’s wiring**.
